svg.title: hybrid-delta31
svg.desc: Delta-rule hybrids from config.json. Qwen3-Next-80B: 12 x (3 GDN + 1 gated attention), 48 layers. Qwen3.5-397B: 15 x (3 + 1), 60 layers. Kimi Linear 48B: 20 KDA + 7 MLA, MLA at layers 4, 8, ..., 24 and 27, so the last group is 2:1. Kimi K3: 69 KDA + 24 gated MLA over 93 layers. Kimi Linear ratio ablation, validation perplexity: 0:1 5.77, 1:1 5.66, 3:1 5.65, 7:1 5.70, 15:1 5.82. Qwen3.8 ablation on a 25B-A3B model, average score: full attention 49.87, SWA hybrid 51.15, GDN hybrid 53.81.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: stack = n × [ 3 × (GDN → MoE) + 1 × (gated attn → MoE) ] n = 12 (3-Next), 15 (3.5)
